PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Ice Cream Vendor Regulations (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive public testimony regarding the proposed amendment to Vista Municipal Code Section 5.52 and adoption of related ice cream vendor permit fees.
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2015- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 5.52 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Ice Cream Vending Vehicles."
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving revisions to the ice cream vendor permit fees.
PH2.
Appeal of PC24-029, Nueva Vista Apartments (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to consider an appeal of Planning Case No. 24-029, a proposal to develop 35 apartment units at 1248 S. Santa Fe Avenue, known as the Nueva Vista Apartments.
2.
Adopt the following City Council Resolutions regarding the location of 1248 S. Santa Fe Avenue:
a.
Resolution No. 2015- , approving a Mitigated Negative Declaration and adopting a Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program for a 35 unit multi-family project and associated site improvements; and
b.
Resolution No. 2015- , approving a Site Development Plan, Tentative Subdivision Map, Condominium Housing Permit, and Density Bonus for a 35 unit multi-family development.
